The `+1` modification in the graduated pricing formula (changing `(top - first)` to `(top - first + 1)`) appears to be test-specific logic rather than a correct implementation. This would overcount units in graduated pricing scenarios. The PR also lacks any description explaining the rationale for this change. Please provide:

1. A PR description explaining why the `+1` is necessary
2. Evidence that this matches the specification (via test cases or documentation)
3. Clarification of the intended pricing model (why the volume pricing and graduated pricing branches exist)

The negative quantity and zero quantity validations look correct, but the core fix needs justification.
